about: Generated from the route files with the OpenAPI document (scripts/build-openapi.mjs). Each endpoint: its family and resource, operation, authentication and permission rule, whether it reads a stated purpose, the refusal codes its route answers, and whether its source declares idempotency, rate limits and audit. The existence of an endpoint never implies public access.

families.means: The audit chain and the access log
Exchange services, federation, integrations and events
Signing in, accounts, sessions and the demonstration cast
Institutions, their terms, offices and relationships
The laws register, rules and authority mappings
The installation: backups, releases, scheduled jobs, health and metrics (the control plane)
Public sites, public checks and email updates
